links.comparator_used: Accepting all GPT-4o predictions without confidence-based triage (baseline accuracy on all test reports)
links.outcome: Accuracy of auto-labeled T-stage and N-stage predictions after confidence-based triage
links.effect: T-stage: accepting 37% (simple prompt) and 34% (structured prompt) of predictions raised accuracy from 0.73 to 0.89 and from 0.81 to 1.00; N-stage: accepting 55% of cases achieved up to 1.00 accuracy (baseline 0.80 simple, 0.83 structured)
links.tradeoff: Only a fraction of reports are auto-labeled (34-37% of T-stage, 55% of N-stage); the remainder is deferred to human review. Accepted predictions were enriched for prototypical labels (e.g., N0 = 91%).
links.quote: Triage thresholds accepting 37% (simple) and 34% (structured) of T-stage predictions raised accuracies to 0.89 and 1.00, respectively; accepting 55% of N-stage cases achieved up to 1.00 accuracy.

links.outcome: Accuracy of T, N, and primary site labels
links.effect: Simple prompt accuracies were 0.73 for T, 0.80 for N, and 0.96 for site; structured prompts raised T to 0.81 and N to 0.83, but reduced site to 0.91.
links.tradeoff: Structured prompts reduced primary-site accuracy (0.96 to 0.91).
links.quote: Simple prompt accuracies were 0.73 for T, 0.80 for N, and 0.96 for site; structured prompts raised T to 0.81 and N to 0.83, but reduced site to 0.91.
